h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Chapra

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Chapra

items.pText: Chapra is the headquarters of Saran district in north Bihar, near where the Ghaghara joins the Ganga. Many of the playground enquiries from towns like Chapra come from small private schools and play schools that are adding an outdoor area for their youngest pupils. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,410 km away, and sends it to Chapra by road.

A play school ground is often a small yard behind the building, sometimes paved, sometimes bare earth. That is enough space for a compact set of equipment sized for children under six. We suggest pieces with low decks and short slides, and seats that hold small children securely. Send us the yard's measurements and a few photos, and we will mark the safe play area for each piece on a layout drawing.

items.q: Can a small play school yard fit playground equipment?
items.a: Usually, yes. A compact multi play station and a couple of spring riders fit most small yards. Send us the measurements and photos and we will show the fit on a layout drawing.

items.q: Is rubber flooring needed for very young children?
items.a: We strongly suggest it. Young children fall often, and rubber flooring cushions those falls far better than tiles, concrete or hard earth.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Saran district?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Chapra by road and install it with our team or a Bihar dealer.
